data.title: What If You Had Put $1,000 Into Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP and Solana 5 Years Ago?
data.description: Buying crypto at the peak of a massive rally sounds like a disaster waiting to happen, but the results across Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana over the past five years tell a far more complicated story than you might expect.
